title: Procedure Inference as Memory: Learning Recruiter Decision Procedures from OKF-Structured Episodes in Multi-Session Hiring Assistants
title_zh: 将流程推断作为记忆：多会话招聘助手从 OKF 结构化交互片段中学习招聘人员的决策流程
abstract_en: Multi-session hiring assistants must infer evolving recruiter preferences and decision patterns across projects and time. We introduce Open Knowledge Format (OKF)-indexed episodic memory to organize interactions and retrieve related events through their lineage. We also introduce Procedure Memory, which learns reusable decision procedures from these episodes through prompted reflection or reinforcement learning. We compare these approaches with no memory, full-history context, and conversation search, and evaluate Jev-class models for index navigation and GPT-5.6 Luna as a lower-cost alternative to GPT-5.4. In our evaluation, OKF-indexed retrieval achieves low-priority preference F1 scores of 0.93-0.95 at medium and high preference overlap between hiring projects. It significantly outperforms full-history context and conversation search in both settings, and no memory at high overlap, while using 69% fewer context tokens than full history. Procedure Memory reduces conversational turns by up to 39% relative to no memory. Qualitative and long-horizon evaluations provide evidence of temporal reasoning, with RL-learned procedures achieving 60% on both correct abstention and exact-field identification. Jev-class models improve conversational efficiency but more frequently miss temporally relevant evidence, highlighting the importance of evidence selection. On PersonaMem-v2, Procedure Memory with OKF retrieval achieves 50.2% accuracy versus 48.6% for full-history context and 29.0% for no memory, using 90.5% fewer reader input tokens than full history. GPT-5.6 Luna performs comparably to GPT-5.4 at lower cost. These findings highlight the value of structured episodic memory and learned decision procedures for efficient personalization and temporal reasoning.
abstract_zh: 多会话招聘助手需要推断招聘人员的偏好和决策模式如何随项目和时间变化。本文提出以 Open Knowledge Format（OKF）为索引的情节记忆，按交互事件的沿袭关系组织和检索相关证据；同时提出 Procedure Memory，通过提示反思或强化学习，从历史片段中提炼可复用的决策流程。实验将这些方法与无记忆、完整历史上下文和会话搜索进行比较。在招聘项目的偏好重叠程度为中等或较高时，OKF 索引检索识别低优先级偏好的 F1 达到 0.93–0.95，显著优于完整历史上下文和会话搜索；在高重叠时也显著优于无记忆，且比完整历史上下文少用 69% 的上下文 token。与无记忆相比，Procedure Memory 最多减少 39% 的对话轮次。长时程评估显示，强化学习得到的流程在正确弃答和精确字段识别两项指标上均达到 60%。Jev 系列模型提高了对话效率，但更容易漏掉时间上相关的证据。在 PersonaMem-v2 上，Procedure Memory 结合 OKF 检索取得 50.2% 的准确率，高于完整历史上下文的 48.6% 和无记忆的 29.0%，同时比完整历史上下文少用 90.5% 的读取模型输入 token。GPT-5.6 Luna 以更低成本达到与 GPT-5.4 相近的表现。
key_points_zh: OKF 按事件沿袭关系检索历史证据；Procedure Memory 则通过提示反思或强化学习，将交互经验提炼为可复用的决策流程。
在项目偏好中高重叠时，OKF 检索识别低优先级偏好的 F1 为 0.93–0.95，比完整历史上下文少用 69% 的上下文 token。
Procedure Memory 相比无记忆最多减少 39% 的对话轮次；强化学习得到的流程在正确弃答和精确字段识别上均达到 60%。
在 PersonaMem-v2 上，组合方法的准确率为 50.2%，完整历史和无记忆分别为 48.6% 和 29.0%；读取模型的输入 token 较完整历史减少 90.5%。
Jev 系列模型提高了对话效率，但更容易遗漏时间相关证据；GPT-5.6 Luna 以更低成本达到与 GPT-5.4 相近的表现。
